question: What is the long passing score of the oldest player?
evidence: long passing score refers to long_passing; oldest player refers to oldest birthday;
clarification: If several rows tie at the cut-off, return all of them.
gold: SELECT c0 FROM (SELECT t2.long_passing AS c0, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.birthday ASC) AS __r FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id) AS __t WHERE __r <= 1
gold0: SELECT t2.long_passing FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id ORDER BY t1.birthday ASC LIMIT 1

d.request: What is the long passing score (long_passing) of the oldest player (the player with the earliest birthday), and if several players tie for the earliest birthday, return the long passing scores of all of them?
d.sql: SELECT pa.long_passing FROM Player_Attributes pa WHERE pa.player_api_id IN (SELECT p.player_api_id FROM Player p WHERE p.birthday = (SELECT MIN(birthday) FROM Player))

c.sql: SELECT pa.long_passing FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.birthday = (SELECT MIN(birthday) FROM Player)

b.request: What are the long_passing values in all Player_Attributes records of every player tied for the earliest birthday in the Player table, including all tied players if several share that earliest birthday?
b.sql: SELECT pa.long_passing FROM Player_Attributes pa WHERE pa.player_api_id IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE birthday = (SELECT MIN(birthday) FROM Player))
